verifications.word-to-pdf: all source Word paragraph and table cell strings across the entire document survive in PDF Unicode text
verifications.excel-to-pdf: every cell from every original worksheet survives as Unicode-equivalent selectable PDF text
verifications.ppt-to-pdf: each PowerPoint slide maps to exactly one PDF page in source order, with all slide text inside visible page bounds
verifications.txt-to-pdf: all original text-file lines retained as selectable PDF text
verifications.html-to-pdf: all visible source HTML heading and table cells preserved as selectable PDF Unicode text
verifications.markdown-to-pdf: original Markdown heading and all source body/table cell texts survive PDF conversion
verifications.csv-to-pdf: all source CSV headers and complete cell values survive PDF's extractable text
